name: add_to_shopping_list
description: Add a grocery item to the user's shopping list.

quantity.description: Optional quantity or amount such as '1 carton' or '2'.

store.description: Optional store tab such as Costco or Whole Foods.

name: add_many_to_shopping_list
description: Add multiple grocery items to the shopping list in one request.

quantity.description: Optional quantity or amount such as '1 carton' or '2'.

store.description: Optional store tab such as Costco or Whole Foods.

name: update_shopping_item_store
description: Move an existing shopping list item to a specific store tab.

item_name.description: The grocery item already on the shopping list.

store.description: The destination store tab such as Costco or Whole Foods.

name: update_many_shopping_item_stores
description: Move multiple existing shopping list items to specific store tabs.

item_name.description: The grocery item already on the shopping list.

name: mark_shopping_item_bought
description: Mark a shopping list item as bought or checked off.

item_name.description: The grocery item to mark as bought.

name: mark_shopping_item_unbought
description: Mark a shopping list item as not bought or unchecked.

item_name.description: The grocery item to mark as not bought.

name: remove_from_shopping_list
description: Remove a grocery item from the user's shopping list.

name: clear_shopping_list
description: Remove every item from the user's shopping list.

name: get_shopping_list
description: Get the current shopping list items.

limit.description: Optional number of shopping list items to return.

name: list_store_tabs
description: List the current shopping store tabs already in use.

name: get_kitchen_overview
description: Get a summary of the current kitchen inventory.

limit.description: Optional number of kitchen items to return.

name: search_kitchen_item
description: Look up a specific item already in the kitchen, including amount left, location, expiration, and opened state when available.

item_name.description: The kitchen item to look up.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

name: check_in_item
description: Add one item to the kitchen inventory.

quantity.description: Optional freeform quantity such as 'half full' or '2 eggs left'.

location.description: Optional kitchen location such as fridge, freezer, or pantry.

expiration_date.description: Optional expiration date, including natural phrases like 'next Friday'.

name: check_in_many_items
description: Add multiple items to the kitchen inventory in one request.

items.description: Kitchen items for the requested operation.

quantity.description: Optional freeform quantity such as 'half full' or '2 eggs left'.

location.description: Optional kitchen location such as fridge, freezer, or pantry.

expiration_date.description: Optional expiration date, including natural phrases like 'next Friday'.

name: update_item_quantity
description: Update the remaining amount or fullness of a kitchen item for partial-state changes, including phrases like 'only 4 left', 'half full', or 'almost empty'. Do not use this when the user wants the item removed from the kitchen entirely.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

remaining_quantity.description: Freeform quantity such as 'half full' or '2 eggs left'.

name: mark_item_opened
description: Mark a kitchen item as opened.

item_name.description: The kitchen item to mark as opened.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

name: update_item_expiration
description: Update the expiration date for a kitchen item.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

expiration_date.description: The expiration date, including natural phrases like 'next Friday'.

name: update_item_location
description: Move a kitchen item to a different storage location.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

location.description: The destination location such as pantry, fridge, or freezer.

name: update_item_details
description: Correct a kitchen item's name or other explicitly requested details. item_name identifies the existing item; new_name is its replacement name. For a name correction, send only the target and new_name. Preserve quantity, brand, opened state and location unless the user explicitly changes them.

new_name.description: The exact replacement name explicitly requested by the user. Do not use this to identify the existing item.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

remaining_quantity.description: Freeform quantity such as 'half full' or '2 eggs left'.

expiration_date.description: Optional expiration date, including natural phrases like 'next Friday'.

location.description: Optional location such as pantry, fridge, or freezer.

name: discard_item
description: Discard or fully remove an item from the kitchen inventory (and log the discard reason if provided). This is the tool to use whenever the user finished / ate / used up / ran out of a kitchen item, or asks to remove / get rid of / take out / toss an item they have — including with a pronoun ('I just had strawberries, remove them'). Use reason 'finished' when they consumed it. If the item isn't in their kitchen it returns not-found — report that honestly.

item_id.description: Optional exact kitchen row id when resolving a previously ambiguous item.

selection_hint.description: Optional disambiguation hint such as most_recent, oldest, or other.

reason.description: Optional discard reason such as spoiled, finished, or moldy.

name: clear_kitchen_inventory
description: Remove every active item from the kitchen inventory in one action.

name: get_recent_discards
description: Get the user's recent discard history, including discarded item names and reasons when available.

limit.description: Optional number of recent discards to return.

name: delete_recent_discard
description: Remove one item from the user's recent discard history.

item_name.description: The discarded item to remove from discard history.

name: clear_recent_discards
description: Remove every item from the user's recent discard history.

name: log_dish_from_voice
description: Log a new meal or food from a voice description.

dish_name.description: The food or meal name such as '2 apples' or 'turkey sandwich'.

serving_size.description: Optional serving description such as '2 apples' or '1 bowl'.

ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

calories.description: Optional calories if the amount is known.

name: log_dish_ingredients
description: Log a new recent dish when the user mainly lists ingredients or foods eaten together.

dish_name.description: Optional short dish name if one is obvious.

ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

name: append_to_recent_dish
description: Append foods or ingredients to the most recent dish context when the user says follow-up phrases like also or add too.

ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

serving_size.description: Optional replacement serving description for the recent dish.

name: update_recent_dish
description: Update the most recent dish context for follow-up changes like add, remove, or revise details.

ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

add_ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

remove_ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

name: get_recent_dishes
description: Get the user's recent dish logs.

limit.description: Optional number of recent dishes to return.

name: get_dish_detail
description: Get details for a specific recent dish, or the recent dish context if no identifier is needed.

dish_name.description: Optional dish name to look up.

name: mark_dish_consumed
description: Mark a dish as finished or consumed.

dish_name.description: Optional dish name to mark consumed.

name: delete_dish_log
description: Delete a recent dish log entry.

name: add_dish_ingredients_to_shopping_list
description: Add ingredients from a dish or recent dish context to the shopping list.

dish_name.description: Optional dish name to source ingredients from.

ingredients.description: Dish ingredients or foods mentioned in the meal.

store.description: Optional store tab for the shopping items.

name: get_health_metrics
description: Get the latest health metrics such as Kitchen IQ, UPF, points, and harmful ingredients.

metric_name.description: Optional specific metric such as Kitchen IQ, UPF, points, or harmful ingredients.

name: get_recipe_suggestions
description: Get current recipe suggestions based on what is in the kitchen and what would need groceries.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of recipes to emphasize from each group.

name: get_recipe_detail
description: Get details for one recipe suggestion, including ingredients, steps, and any missing grocery items.

recipe_title.description: The recipe title to look up.

recipe_bucket.description: Optional recipe group such as kitchen_only or need_grocery.

name: add_recipe_ingredients_to_shopping_list
description: Add ingredients for a recipe suggestion to the shopping list, usually the missing grocery items.

recipe_title.description: The recipe title to source ingredients from.

recipe_bucket.description: Optional recipe group such as kitchen_only or need_grocery.

only_missing.description: If true, add only missing grocery items. If false, add the full ingredient list.

store.description: Optional store tab for the shopping items.

name: get_saved_recipes
description: Get the user's saved recipes, including recipes imported from TikTok links, Instagram Reels, or recipe webpages.

limit.description: Optional number of saved recipes to return.

name: get_saved_recipe_detail
description: Get one saved recipe by title, including ingredients, instructions, notes, and source link.

recipe_title.description: The saved recipe title to look up.

name: search_web_recipes
description: Search the web for recipes matching a query. Use when the user asks for a specific recipe not found in their suggestions or saved recipes, or wants recipes for specific dietary needs, allergies, cuisines, or ingredients.

query.description: The recipe search query, e.g. 'gluten free apple crumble' or 'quick chicken dinner for two'.

max_results.description: Optional maximum number of recipes to return, default 3.

name: save_recipe_from_tiktok
description: Import a recipe from a TikTok link, Instagram Reel URL, or recipe webpage URL and save it to the user's saved recipes.

url.description: A TikTok recipe link to import.

name: save_generated_recipe
description: Save a recipe that YOU generated or described in this chat (not from a URL and not one of their existing saved/suggested recipes) to the user's saved recipes. Pass the exact title, ingredients, and ordered steps you presented.

title.description: The recipe title exactly as presented.

steps.description: The ordered preparation steps you listed.

name: remove_saved_recipe
description: Remove a saved recipe by title from the user's saved recipes.

recipe_title.description: The saved recipe title to remove.

name: add_saved_recipe_ingredients_to_shopping_list
description: Add ingredients from a saved recipe to the shopping list.

recipe_title.description: Optional saved recipe title to source ingredients from.

store.description: Optional store tab for the shopping items.

name: get_meal_plan
description: Get the current meal plan, including current focus and regeneration status.

name: refresh_meal_plan
description: Regenerate the meal plan, optionally with a new focus such as higher protein or easier meals.

focus.description: Optional meal-plan focus such as higher protein, cheaper meals, or great overall health.

name: recommend_items_to_buy
description: Recommend grocery items to buy next based on current kitchen and shopping context.

limit.description: Optional number of recommendations to return.

name: recommend_items_to_use_up
description: Recommend kitchen items to use soon based on expiration, opened state, or low stock.

limit.description: Optional number of recommendations to return.

name: list_recipe_categories
description: List the user's custom saved-recipe categories (their own tags/folders for organizing saved recipes). Use this to see what categories exist before offering to file a recipe.

name: create_recipe_category
description: Create a new custom saved-recipe category (tag/folder) by name, without filing any recipe into it yet. Idempotent — if a category with that name already exists it is returned unchanged. Use when the user explicitly asks to make/add a new category. This does NOT log a dish and does NOT save a recipe.

category_name.description: The name of the category to create, e.g. 'Seafood' or 'Weeknight Dinners'.

name: move_recipe_to_category
description: File saved recipe(s) into one of the user's custom recipe categories (tag/folder). Adds the tag without removing existing tags. If the named category doesn't exist yet, it is created automatically. Identify a single recipe by title (recipe_name), or file several at once with recipe_names (an array of titles). This does NOT log a dish and does NOT save a new recipe.

recipe_name.description: A single saved recipe's title to file (use the exact title, e.g. the recipe you just saved).

recipe_names.description: Optional: file MULTIPLE saved recipes at once, by their titles. Each is resolved independently and reported per-recipe.

recipe_id.description: Optional saved recipe id, if known. When provided it is used instead of recipe_name to resolve a single recipe.

category_name.description: The custom category to file the recipe(s) under, e.g. 'Gluten-Free' or 'Weeknight Dinners'. Created if it doesn't exist.

name: get_meal_calendar
description: View the user's planned meal calendar (recipes they've scheduled onto specific days and meal slots). Use this to see what's already planned before adding — e.g. to avoid double-booking a slot or to compose a plan. This is the hand-planned calendar, NOT the auto-generated meal plan (get_meal_plan).

start_date.description: Optional start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

end_date.description: Optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to about a week out.

name: add_recipe_to_meal_calendar
description: Schedule ONE saved recipe onto the user's meal calendar for a specific date and meal slot. Resolve the recipe by title (recipe_name). This plans a meal to cook later — it does NOT log a dish the user ate and does NOT save a new recipe. Confirm only after the tool returns ok:true; if it returns recipe_not_found / recipe_ambiguous / invalid_date, say so honestly and do not claim it was scheduled.

recipe_name.description: The saved recipe's title to schedule.

recipe_id.description: Optional saved recipe id, if known (used instead of recipe_name).

plan_date.description: The date to schedule it on (YYYY-MM-DD). Resolve relative dates like 'tomorrow' against today's date given in the system prompt.

meal_slot.description: Which meal slot on that day.

name: add_many_to_meal_calendar
description: Schedule MULTIPLE saved recipes onto the meal calendar in one call. Each entry is resolved and written independently and reported per-entry (partial success is possible). Use this to commit a whole proposed plan AFTER the user has explicitly confirmed it. Plans meals to cook later — never a dish log or a recipe save.

name: add_generated_recipes_to_meal_calendar
description: Add recipes YOU composed yourself (not the user's saved recipes) to the meal calendar as MEAL-PLAN-ONLY entries. Use this when the user asks you to GENERATE/CREATE/'make me' a meal plan or recipes rather than schedule existing saved ones. Each entry carries the full recipe inline (title + ingredients + numbered instructions); it shows in the meal plan and renders on tap but does NOT create a saved recipe. Only call AFTER the user has explicitly confirmed the plan you proposed in text. Never a dish log or a recipe save. Written per-entry (partial success possible); report only what actually landed.

entries.description: The generated recipes to place on the calendar (max 21).

plan_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD). Resolve relative dates against today first.

title.description: The generated recipe's title (a real dish name, e.g. 'Lemon Garlic Chicken').

ingredients.description: The full ingredient list (each an item string). At least one required.

instructions.description: The numbered preparation steps, each a string.

meal_category.description: Optional category label. Never a reserved sentinel.

name: move_meal_calendar_entry
description: Move an already-scheduled meal calendar entry to a new date (and optionally a new meal slot). Identify the entry by entry_id if known, otherwise by title (plus from_date to disambiguate). If it can't be pinned down it returns entry_not_found / entry_ambiguous — say so honestly and do not claim it moved.

entry_id.description: The calendar entry's id, if known.

title.description: The scheduled recipe's title, if the id isn't known.

from_date.description: Optional current date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the entry, to disambiguate by title.

from_meal_slot.description: Optional current meal slot, to disambiguate by title.

new_date.description: The new date to move it to (YYYY-MM-DD).

new_meal_slot.description: Optional new meal slot (keeps the current slot if omitted).

name: remove_meal_calendar_entry
description: Remove a scheduled entry from the user's meal calendar. Identify it by entry_id if known, otherwise by title (plus plan_date and/or meal_slot to disambiguate). If it can't be pinned down it returns entry_not_found / entry_ambiguous — say so honestly and do not claim it was removed.

entry_id.description: The calendar entry's id, if known.

title.description: The scheduled recipe's title, if the id isn't known.

plan_date.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) to disambiguate by title.

meal_slot.description: Optional meal slot to disambiguate by title.
